## Goal
The service maps HTTP paths to handler callables.

## Files touched

## Details
Implement the router described under HTTP surface in the README: register(method, path, handler) and dispatch(method, path) returning 404 for an unknown route. Do not import the store here; wiring happens in a later ticket so this file has exactly one owner.
